about: What a person can know how to do (docs/knowledge-and-progression.md, 3.1). A technique names the processes it lets someone operate and is never a property of matter.

techniques.name: Rough-shaping wood
techniques.describes: Taking wood off a piece of stock with a supported shaping process until it has a wanted outline

any_of.says: Study the wooden pick you were given: how it was shaped is in the shape of it.

techniques.name: Smelting copper
techniques.describes: Working copper ore into copper with heat, in a machine that holds a batch

any_of.says: Watch a smelter work copper ore into copper, once.

techniques.name: Drawing wire
techniques.describes: Pulling copper down into wire, which is what a machine's windings are made of

any_of.says: Watch a mill draw copper into wire, once.
